answer: Simultaneous supervised attendance. To qualify for canyon mapping, jade inspection, or vine survey rewards, a person must remain in a staffed booth for the entire shared enrollment window and answer fresh challenges. Staff admit one person per booth and reject remote relays. One operator cannot occupy N booths simultaneously, so N eligible accounts require N recruited people and their time and travel costs. This assumes honest supervision and synchronized windows; corrupt staff or staggered sessions let one person collect several credentials.
